stories.title: ‘The audience gets to be in on it’: How narrative-led gameplay is Call of Duty’s greatest weapon
stories.summary: Modern Warfare 4 makes narrative-led gameplay central to Call of Duty's appeal, even as the wider games industry pursues ever-larger spectacle. The approach aims to involve players in the story by putting character and consequences at the heart of the game's biggest battles.

stories.title: Cocaine-Funded Gangs Shake Colombia Years After Peace Pact
stories.summary: Cocaine-funded militias are attacking civilians in Colombia eight years after a peace accord removed a major rebel group from the conflict. The violence is presented as evidence of state inaction that allowed powerful gangs to fill the vacuum left by the accord.

links.headline: Cocaine-Funded Gangs Shake Colombia Years After Peace Pact
links.excerpt: Attacks by powerful militias against civilians reflect the state’s inaction eight years after a peace accord removed a powerful rebel group from the field.

stories.title: Canada Is Becoming a Fentanyl Exporter, and a Target for Trump
stories.summary: Fentanyl is increasingly being manufactured in and trafficked from Canada, making the country an exporter of the drug and a target for President Trump. The reported volumes remain small compared with those linked to Mexico.

links.headline: Canada Is Becoming a Fentanyl Exporter, and a Target for Trump
links.excerpt: The drug is increasingly manufactured in and trafficked from the U.S.’s northern neighbor, though the numbers remain small compared with Mexico.
